## Everything new since RustWarden 1.0

### Plugins
- Settings > Plugins replaces Integrations. Every integration is now a sandboxed plugin: Home Assistant, VirusTotal, Speedtest, Ping Monitor, Prometheus Metrics, Discord, Slack, Pushbullet, ntfy, Gotify and webhooks.
- New built-in plugins: UPnP Port Forwarding, Cloudflare Tunnel, Shodan InternetDB and AbuseIPDB.
- Plugin search, a permissions dialog, uninstall and "Reinstall default plugins", and Install from file with a file picker.
- ThinkBroadband Quality Monitor and OPNsense are beta plugins, hidden until you type "beta" in the plugin search box and press Enter.
- Want to build your own? "Create a Plugin" on the Plugins page opens a step-by-step guide to the plugin SDK.

### Detection and alerts
- New alerts: regular check-ins (beaconing, with a scoring system and an app picker to ignore programs you trust), DNS tunnelling, and, in Driver mode, rogue DHCP servers and browser TLS impersonation.
- Fewer false alarms from DHCP on virtual adapters, MAC address changes and beaconing.
- Desktop popups start off on a new install, so new users aren't flooded. Existing settings are kept.
- Alert popups are always RustWarden's own, even when it started hidden in the tray.

### Protection
- VPN kill switch and Block DNS-over-HTTPS resolvers (Settings > Privacy > VPN).
- Driver mode extras: Force DNS through your resolver, QUIC fallback, line-speed priorities, and host names per program even when DNS is encrypted.
- "Block an app by clicking it" from the RustWarden and tray menus.
- Security hardening: a tamper password that can't be bypassed through config.toml, no standing firewall exceptions for helper tools, verified helper programs, limits on plugin database calls, and safer CSV exports.

### Easier to use
- Settings is split into tabs, so there is far less scrolling, and related options now sit together.
- A fast first-run wizard: a few quick choices, and the databases your features need.
- Database downloads ask once, show the total size and have a single progress bar. GeoIP databases update on a schedule you set.
- A new About page.

### Fixes
- The Hardware tab no longer races at thousands of frames a second after the PC wakes from sleep.
- The Settings window no longer grows wider when you open some alert types.
- Traffic > Hosts names shared CDN addresses correctly per program.
- Many plugin fixes for UPnP, Cloudflare Tunnel and notification delivery (alerts are held while offline and sent later).
